io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories

Class CategoryItemGroup

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.ItemGroup
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.groups.FlexItemGroup
        • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories.CategoryItemGroup
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Keyed

    public class CategoryItemGroup
extends FlexItemGroup
    A transient top-level guide tile for one GuideCategory, built per guide-open from the player's currently-visible groups so it never enters the global item-group registry. Clicking it lists the category's member groups via SurvivalSlimefunGuide.openCategoryContents(io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.player.PlayerProfile, io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories.CategoryItemGroup, int).

      • open

        public void open(org.bukkit.entity.Player p,
                 PlayerProfile profile,
                 SlimefunGuideMode mode)
        Description copied from class: FlexItemGroup
        This method is called when a Player opens this FlexItemGroup. This is an abstract method which needs to be implemented in order to determine what this FlexItemGroup should actually do as it cannot hold any items.
        Specified by:
        open in class FlexItemGroup
        Parameters:
        p - The Player who wants to open this FlexItemGroup
